description: SOLIDWORKS' own units: metres and radians, not the mm and degrees of every other tool. The escape hatch: calls any member of SOLIDWORKS' API that the other tools do not cover yet, by late binding. target is app (ISldWorks), document (the document's IModelDoc2) or a reference (the face, edge, feature or other entity it names; a feature's, plane's, axis's or point's name works too, and front, top, right and origin). member is a dotted path: every part but the last a property or a method without arguments, the last called with args (Extension.GetMassProperties2). args are JSON; {"ref": "r1..."} passes the entity a reference (or a feature's name) names. The result is the member's value as JSON, ref and out arguments in out, and an object as its reference when SOLIDWORKS can persist it, else only its interface's name: there are no handles, so a chain of calls is one dotted member. With rebuild (the default for document and reference targets) the document is rebuilt afterwards and its rebuild errors returned; a call that rebuilds waits (busy, user_editing) while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open, and one with rebuild false, or on app, does not wait. Nothing is checked and nothing is rolled back: it does what it is told. Refused: the members that end SOLIDWORKS, close documents or run code (ExitApp, CloseAllDocuments, CloseDoc, QuitDoc, CloseAndReopen and every other Close or Quit member of ISldWorks and IModelDoc2, RunMacro, RunMacro2, RunCommand, LoadAddIn, UnloadAddIn), and those that close a document under another name (every member containing Reload, ForceReleaseLocks, SetReadOnlyState, the Replace… members that swap a document, ConnectToSW, DisconnectFromSW), and every other member that runs code (RunAttachedMacro, RunJournalCmd, RunBatchSaveProcess, the callback members, the macro-feature members, RunXMLCommand, WriteJournalToMacro, EmbedMacroFile, GetAddInObject); close a document with document.close. Every call is logged in full to api-calls.log. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

target.description: What to call the member on: app (ISldWorks), document (the document's IModelDoc2), or an entity of the document: its reference (r1.…), or the name of a feature, plane, axis or point (Boss-Extrude1; front, top, right, origin).

document.description: The document: its title or full path. The active document when absent. The one a document or reference target is in, and the one rebuilt.

member.description: The member, or a dotted path to it: SOLIDWORKS' API names, for example GetTitle, Extension.GetMassProperties2, FeatureManager.FeatureExtrusion3.

args.description: The last member's arguments in order, in SOLIDWORKS' units (metres, radians): numbers, strings, booleans, arrays, null, and {"ref": "r1..."} for an entity (a reference, or the name of a feature, plane, axis or point). A placeholder (0 or null) for each out argument.

rebuild.description: Rebuild the document afterwards and report its rebuild errors. Default true for document and reference targets, false for app. A call that rebuilds waits (busy) while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open; one that does not rebuild never waits.
